title: Familiar
summary: Rust template and CLI for agent allowances, approved payees, pause and recall. November 5 review: repository revision 73b01af and its October 21 release remain unchanged. The public page and both creator videos remain accessible; its 27-transaction walkthrough is historical October 21 evidence. The read-only indexer control now fails for both leashes with a missing up field. The original X announcement is readable, but one reply is unavailable. Amount mode exposes payment amounts; coupon mode hides denominations while coupon counts, linked accounts and transaction fees remain public. The retained October 23 clip walks through creator-recorded results, not a new agent or wallet run. MIT prototype; the available CLI binaries were not executed. Esmeralda was reset November 2, so the historical deployment and recordings do not establish current network availability.
cardSummary: Give AI agents a revocable testnet allowance with network-enforced spending limits and approved payees.
creator: ArturBaranouski
